observations.summary: A running toilet can waste up to 200 gallons a day; fixing leaks is part of efficient water use that protects the septic system; excess water slows or stops treatment and can flood the drainfield. Fetched directly on 2026-10-25 for the merged septic maintenance and drain field posts.
Toilet food coloring test: wait 10 minutes without flushing, color in the bowl means a leak; replace flappers at least every five years. Same source already cited by the merged hidden leak post.
